test-author finding 1: done — Reverted DSCLA-10 to the iter-3-attempt-1 formulation that passed the design check. The Then was "the string is found in the file" — explicitly disallowed by the SPEC rules ("never what a file contains"). The correct formulation has `Given: zbuild:claimed is on the issue`, `When: the run is refused and emits pipeline.refused.claimed`, `Then: the event-schema emitted-coverage check does not fail on pipeline.refused.claimed as an unregistered event`. This is an observable outcome (the check's pass/fail result), not file content. The test-author must write the test to run the coverage check as the SPEC describes, not replace it with a grep of the JSON file.
